# SecurityWeek

> > SecurityWeek is a leading cybersecurity news and events platform covering enterprise security, supply chain risk, threat intelligence, and security leadership.

SecurityWeek delivers cybersecurity insights through virtual summits, podcasts with industry leaders, and analysis of emerging threats. The platform features expert commentary from security professionals at organizations like Cisco, Google Cloud, Goldman Sachs, and the Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF).

## Key Topics

- Supply Chain Security
- Enterprise Security
- Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
- SBOM (Software Bill of Materials)
- Ransomware Resilience
- Threat Detection & Incident Response
- AI & Automation in Cybersecurity
- Open Source Security
- CISO Leadership
- Vendor Risk Management
- Secure by Design
- Software Transparency
- Industrial IoT Security
- Security Leadership
- Threat Intelligence

## Virtual Summits & Events

- [Supply Chain Security & Third-Party Risk Summit](https://supplychain.securityweek.com/): Virtual summit on supply chain security, SBOM, VEX & third-party risk mgmt
- [Ransomware Resilience & Recovery Summit](https://threatsummit.securityweek.com/): Virtual summit on ransomware resilience, recovery & CISO panel discussions
- [Cyber AI & Automation Summit](https://cyberai.securityweek.com/): Virtual event on AI security, automation & attack surface reduction with Snyk
- [Threat Detection and Incident Response Summit](https://tdirsummit.securityweek.com/): Virtual summit on threat detection, incident response & AI cybersecurity

## Podcasts & Interviews

- [SecurityWeek Podcast](https://podcast.securityweek.com/): Podcast series with cybersecurity leaders on trends, threats & enterprise defense
